dct_description_sm: Historical baseline for OSM buildings that includes buildings not modified or digitized after March 20 2025 Building footprints across the region from OSM. Includes every feature tagged as a building (building=*), from residential homes through hospitals, schools, and places of worship. Useful for population estimation, damage assessment, and urban planning. OpenStreetMap is a free, collaborative world map built by volunteers. Completeness varies by region: urban areas are usually well-mapped, remote areas may be incomplete. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. Source: OpenStreetMap OSM tags: Key:building Part of many exports grid on HDX by the HOT
